data.description: Nad Al Hamar: A Thriving Community Built for Tomorrow

data.answer:
Despite being a relatively small neighborhood, Nad Al Hamar, Dubai, has gained interest from investors and tenants seeking a quiet yet well-connected residential area. While it sits on the outskirts of the city, the community doesn’t feel isolated. Its proximity to key developments like Dubai Festival City, Dubai Creek Harbour, and International City ensures residents have access to a vibrant urban environment just minutes away.

Housing in Nad Al Hamar, Dubai, is thoughtfully laid out to balance convenience and privacy. Apartments are typically clustered along the main road, making them easily accessible, while villas are nestled deeper within the community, offering a more secluded and secure living experience. Greenery is a defining feature of the neighborhood, with tree-lined streets, well-maintained parks, and many villas boasting private gardens, creating a refreshing suburban atmosphere.

Nad Al Hamar is gradually emerging as an attractive investment destination with a balanced mix of residential and commercial spaces. The area offers 6 million square feet of vacant residential and commercial plots, providing significant opportunities for investors and developers. With a well-planned infrastructure and a focus on green spaces and landscaped areas, the community is shaping into a family-friendly neighborhood with a peaceful suburban appeal.

Residential properties in the area are primarily low to mid-rise buildings, offering a mix of apartments and villas. The development strategy emphasizes accessibility, with the community well-connected to major highways and key business districts. As more projects take shape, Nad Al Hamar is poised to become a well-integrated community offering both modern living and investment potential.

Popular Buildings in Nad Al Hamar

While Nad Al Hamar is primarily known for its villas and low-rise residential communities, there are a few prominent buildings that stand out for their modern architecture and well-planned layouts. Two of the most popular residential buildings in the area include Wasl Nad Al Hamar Apartments and Nad Al Hamar Plaza.

Wasl Nad Al Hamar Apartments is a sought-after residential complex featuring a mix of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments. The layouts are designed to offer spacious living areas, modern kitchens, and well-ventilated bedrooms. Many units also come with balconies offering community views. Residents enjoy access to essential amenities, including dedicated parking, security services, and landscaped outdoor areas.

Nad Al Hamar Plaza, offers a combination of studio, 1, and 2-bedroom apartments. The apartments here feature open-plan layouts with large windows, allowing plenty of natural light. Studio apartments cater to single professionals, while the larger units are ideal for families seeking affordability and comfort.

Off-Plan Projects in Nad Al Hamar

One of the most anticipated developments in the area is Nad Al Hamar Gardens, a mixed-use project by Wasl Properties. Strategically located along Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, this sub-community is designed to introduce a diverse range of properties, including 69 residential plots, 32 mixed-use plots, 12 showroom plots, and two school plots. With a focus on sustainability and livability, the project will feature low to mid-rise residential buildings complemented by ample green spaces, making it a highly desirable community for residents and investors alike.

Another upcoming development set to transform the area is the mixed-use project by Amlak Finance. Covering approximately 700,000 square feet, this large-scale venture will include a 15-floor residential and commercial tower, a full-service hotel, a shopping mall, and a range of social and recreational amenities. Designed to enhance the area’s urban appeal, this development is expected to attract both homebuyers and businesses looking for a strategic location within Dubai’s expanding real estate market.

Renting a Property in Nad Al Hamar

Nad Al Hamar offers a variety of rental options, including both apartments and villas, catering to diverse preferences and family sizes. The average annual rental prices for apartments are:

  • Studio Apartments: AED 45,000
  • 1-Bedroom Apartments: AED 58,000
  • 2-Bedroom Apartments: AED 80,000
  • 3-Bedroom Apartments: AED 109,000

For those interested in more spacious accommodations, villas in Nad Al Hamar are available with rental prices typically ranging from AED 185,000 to AED 650,000 per year, depending on size and amenities. 

Buying a Property in Nad Al Hamar

Investing in Nad Al Hamar's real estate market presents opportunities in both apartments and villas. The average sale price for apartments is approximately AED 1,207,315, while villas average around AED 9,370,250.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Nad Al Hamar, Dubai?

data.answer:
Life in Nad Al Hamar, Dubai, offers a blend of peaceful suburban living with easy access to urban conveniences, making it an ideal choice for families and professionals alike.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Nad Al Hamar

The Nad Al Hamar location offers excellent connectivity to key parts of Dubai through major road networks. Rebat Street (D83) links the area to Deira, while Ras Al Khor Road (E44) provides a direct route to Downtown Dubai. On the western side, Nad Al Hamar Road serves as a convenient route for travelers heading to Dubai International Airport. Meanwhile, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311) runs along the eastern boundary, offering quick access to Dubailand’s major developments.
Residents benefit from ample parking spaces, with private parking available for villas and apartments, while visitors can use designated bays outside the properties.

Public transportation in the area is limited, as buses do not operate within the community itself. However, bus stops can be found along the main roads bordering the neighborhood. Those looking for the Nad Al Hamar nearest metro station will need to travel to adjacent areas, as the metro network does not extend directly into the community.

Supermarkets in Nad Al Hamar

Grocery shopping in the area is convenient, with a variety of options catering to different needs. Aswaaq Supermarket serves as a key retail destination, offering a diverse selection of household essentials and fresh produce. In addition to larger supermarkets, smaller stores like Al Rufaidha Grocery and Nad Al Hamar Star provide quick and easy access to daily necessities, making it simple for residents to shop close to home.

Shopping Malls in and Near Nad Al Hamar

Residents of Nad Al Hamar enjoy convenient retail options, with Amaya Plaza serving as the community’s primary shopping destination. This local mall features a selection of stores, including La Perla Beauty Centre for personal care, Toddler Touch Studio for children’s essentials, and Home Town, a casual dining restaurant offering a cozy atmosphere.

For those with an active lifestyle, Sports in Life specializes in outdoor sports gear, while Sports Souq provides a variety of general athletic goods, catering to fitness enthusiasts and athletes. Adding a touch of East Asian pop culture to the neighborhood, Trendy Kawaii Japan is a vibrant fashion store located in the southwestern part of the community, offering unique and playful apparel.

For a more extensive shopping experience, residents can visit Mirdif City Centre and Dubai Festival City Mall, both just a short drive away. These larger malls offer a wide range of luxury and high-end retail stores, diverse dining options, and entertainment facilities, making them popular shopping destinations near Nad Al Hamar.

School and Nursery in Nad Al Hamar

Nad Al Hamar is a growing community with a focus on enhancing its educational infrastructure. While several schools are planned for the future, The City School International is currently the main operational school in the area, offering quality education. 

For younger children, Blue Bird Nursery provides a well-rounded early learning environment, making it a convenient option for families with toddlers. As the neighborhood continues to develop, more educational institutions are expected to be introduced, further enriching the community’s offerings.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and Near Nad Al Hamar

Mosques are easily accessible throughout the community, providing convenient prayer spaces for residents. Some of the well-known mosques in the area include Masjid Fatimah Bint Mohammed, Al Kazim Masjid near Nad Al Hamar Park, Hafsa Bint Omar Masjid on 57 B Street, and Afraa Al Katbi Masjid near Nad Al Hamar Road. For special Islamic occasions, the Nad Al Hamar Musalla serves as a dedicated prayer hall for large congregational gatherings, including Eid prayers.

For those seeking places of worship for other faiths, several churches are located in Oud Metha, approximately 22 minutes away. Some of the well-known ones include St. Mary’s Catholic Church, The Dubai City Church, and St. Thomas Orthodox Cathedral, offering services for the Christian community.

Hindu temples are mainly found in Bur Dubai, close to Oud Metha, where worshippers can visit the Shiva and Krishna temples. The Sikh Gurudwara is also in the same area, providing a place of worship for the Sikh community. Additionally, Automech Gurudwara, another Sikh temple, is located in Ras Al Khor Industrial Area, about 12 minutes away.

Clinics and Hospitals in and Near Nad Al Hamar

Access to healthcare is a crucial factor for any community, and Nad Al Hamar is equipped with essential medical facilities to meet residents' needs. City Centre Clinic, located on Rebat Street, provides general medical services, while Nad Al Hamar Health Centre near 33rd Street offers comprehensive healthcare solutions. For everyday pharmaceutical needs, Life Pharmacy on 24 B Street ensures that residents have quick access to medications and health essentials.

For specialized treatments and emergency care, Mediclinic Welcare Hospital in Al Garhoud is the nearest major hospital, located approximately 13 minutes away. As the community continues to expand, more healthcare facilities are expected to enhance medical services in the area.

Location & Nearby Areas

To the north, Nad Shamma is a small yet well-established residential area, separated from Nad Al Hamar location by Rebat Street. Once part of the larger Al Rashidiya district, this neighborhood features spacious villas and townhouses, catering to families seeking larger living spaces. The standout feature of Nad Shamma is Nad Shamma Park, a vast recreational space with four football fields, jogging tracks, children's play areas, and ornamental plants imported from Seychelles, making it a scenic and activity-filled destination.

On the western side, Dubai Festival City is a prominent neighboring development, connected to Nad Al Hamar via Vista Boulevard Street. Branded as a ‘city-within-a-city’, it offers a mix of leisure, retail, and dining experiences in a modern, sustainable setting. With world-class shopping malls, waterfront attractions, and vibrant entertainment options, Dubai Festival City enhances the lifestyle offerings near Nad Al Hamar.

To the east, Al Warqa is a master-planned residential community featuring a variety of housing options. With its mix of villas, apartments, and community amenities, Al Warqaa serves as another convenient and well-connected neighborhood, adding to the appeal of Nad Al Hamar’s surrounding areas.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Nad Al Hamar

data.answer:
Nad Al Hamar may be a quiet residential community, but it offers a variety of activities, from shopping and dining to outdoor recreation and fitness.

Nad Al Hamar Restaurants

Nad Al Hamar restaurants offer a diverse dining experience, from South Asian cuisine to casual eateries and sweet treats. For Pakistani and Indian food, popular options include Eat and Drink Restaurant, New Sarhad Darbar Restaurant, Pearl Star Restaurant, Maraheb Restaurant, and Caesars Restaurant. Pizza lovers can enjoy wood-fired flavors at Paavo’s Pizza in Eppco Al Rowdah Station.
For those with a sweet tooth, Dandy Chocolate Factory and Le Chocola specialize in designer chocolates and gourmet gift baskets, while Fresh and Nice Cafeteria offers quick snacks, and Ice Lab serves a variety of ice creams and desserts.

For fine dining, Dubai Festival City hotels feature top-rated options like Zaytoun, Belgian Beer Cafe, and Skyline Lounge at Crowne Plaza, along with The Fish House, Black Tap, and Anise at

InterContinental DFC. Licensed venues such as Vista Bar and Terrace, Eclipse, and Pierre’s Bistro & Bar add to the upscale dining experience nearby.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness and Beauty

Though not as vast as some of Dubai’s larger parks, Nad Al Hamar Park has its own charm. Located on 47th Street, it’s a popular spot for outdoor activities, featuring jogging tracks, sandy areas for ball games, and shaded benches for relaxation. The park provides a refreshing space for families and fitness enthusiasts to enjoy the outdoors.

For those looking to stay active, the community offers well-equipped fitness centers catering to different workout styles. Power Fit Gym, Bel Remaitha Club, and Platform Fitness Gym are some of the top choices, with CrossFit programs and extensive training classes designed to boost endurance and strength.

Residents also have access to high-quality beauty and wellness services, with a range of salons and spas offering professional treatments. AJ’s Salon, Lush Lounge Ladies Salon, La Perla Beauty Centre, and Les Soeurs Nail Bar cater to women, while Kiddy Couture provides grooming services for children. Thaqeb Gents Salon ensures that male residents have their own dedicated grooming spot, making self-care and relaxation easily accessible within the neighborhood.

Community Events

To enjoy community spirit, people can head over to the the vibrant Dubai Festival City Mall, it is a hotspot for some of the city’s most exciting events. At its heart is the Festival Arena, a massive venue that has hosted large-scale concerts and performances, including the internationally renowned ‘Unite with Tomorrowland’ EDM festival in 2017. With a lineup of concerts, exhibitions, and live shows, this venue continues to attract entertainment lovers from across Dubai.

For a more immersive cultural and entertainment experience, Dubai Creek Harbour, located about 15 kilometers away, offers the trendy #RiseDubai event. This seasonal festival blends food, shopping, art, and live performances, creating a dynamic waterfront experience for visitors. Whether it’s enjoying gourmet street food, discovering local artists, or engaging in interactive entertainment, #RiseDubai is a must-visit attraction for those looking for a unique day out.

Attractions and Landmarks

Residents and visitors looking for a unique experience can take a dhow cruise or an abra ride along the Dubai Water Canal from the pier near Dubai Festival City Mall. The dhow cruise offers a 2.5-hour journey with a three-course dinner and scenic city views, while the abra ride, a traditional Emirati transport, provides a 1.5-hour tour showcasing Dubai’s stunning skyline.

For movie enthusiasts, several cinemas are within a 15-minute drive. VOX Cinemas in City Centre Mirdif and Novo Cinemas in Dubai Festival City Mall offer the latest blockbusters, while another Novo Cinemas in Dragon Mart 2 provides an alternative nearby option for an immersive cinematic experience.

Nad Al Hamar offers a peaceful residential environment with well-connected road networks, making it easy to access key areas of Dubai. The community is continually developing, with new real estate projects, schools, and commercial spaces enhancing its appeal. While public transport options within the neighborhood are limited, the area’s proximity to major highways ensures smooth commuting. With a growing number of amenities, green spaces, and lifestyle facilities, Nad Al Hamar is shaping up to be a well-rounded and convenient place to live.

Are Nad Al Hamar and Nad Al Hammar the same?

Yes, Nad Al Hammar and Nad Al Hamar refer to the same area in Dubai. The difference in spelling arises from transliteration variations from Arabic to English. 

Is Nad Al Hamar a freehold area?

Yes, Nad Al Hamar is a freehold area, allowing both locals and expatriates to purchase property. 

What amenities are available in Nad Al Hamar?

The community offers various amenities, including parks, schools, mosques, shopping malls, and fitness centers, catering to the needs of residents.
Take a glimpse into the well-planned layout of Nad Al Hamar, showcasing its key roads, landmarks, and community highlights.

data.content:
Nad Al Hamar Dubai has grown into a promising community, offering a mix of residential and commercial spaces. Developers like Wasl Properties and Amlak Finance have introduced high-quality housing options, making the neighborhood an attractive choice for those seeking a quieter lifestyle while staying well-connected to the rest of the city.

One of the key advantages of Nad Al Hamar’s location is its accessibility. Positioned near major highways, it provides seamless connectivity to key business and entertainment hubs. The area also borders Ras Al Khor Industrial Area, making it a convenient choice for professionals working in the industrial sector. With a blend of residential and commercial developments, the neighborhood offers a balanced environment for both families and businesses.

Despite its industrial presence, Nad Al Hamar has maintained a comfortable and community-oriented atmosphere. The area features a selection of villas and apartments, primarily available for rent. Additionally, it is home to a dedicated mosque for Eid prayers, serving as a central space for religious gatherings. As new developments continue, Nad Al Hamar is steadily transforming into a well-rounded and desirable neighborhood in Dubai.
